storyCards.headline: No Sleep: The Breakthrough Moment
storyCards.fact:
Wiz Khalifa's "No Sleep" reached #6 on the Billboard Hot 100. "No Sleep" is a song by American rapper Wiz Khalifa, released as the ninth official single from his debut major-label studio album, Rolling Papers.

The song peaked at #6 on the Billboard Hot 100 and spent 15 weeks on the chart.

No Sleep was released in 2011.
